description:
Ask your recruiting data anything. The Tenzo AI MCP server connects your AI assistant to your hiring pipeline, so instead of clicking through screens you can just ask: who applied for this role, where each candidate stands, how they did on their AI screening call, and what's changed this week.

Pull up a candidate and follow them end to end - their applications and stages, resume, SMS and email history, and the full screening-call transcript, grade, and summary. Check how a job is configured, review meeting notes, and surface hiring analytics, all in plain language.

Access is read-only and OAuth-authenticated, so the assistant can read your data but never change it, and everything stays scoped to your organization.
